info.title: Agent Platform Agent API (internal)
info.description: Internal API called only by the gateway (README §6.2).

200.description: Server-sent events; each `data` is an AgentEvent (docs/events.schema.json).

409.description: turn_in_flight: another turn holds the conversation

429.description: too_many_turns: the caller's or its tenant's turns in flight are at their limit

503.description: service_busy: the platform's turns in flight are at capacity, or ownership and the lock took longer than admission_s

post.description:
Withdraws a persisted reply from the history (ADR-0048). Called by the gateway
when a finished turn's audit record cannot be written.

204.description: The reply is marked retracted; Context Assembly no longer includes it.

409.description: turn_in_flight: a turn kept the conversation locked

503.description: service_busy: every turn lock connection is in use

get.description:
The caller's own memory items and memory switch (README §8). No endpoint reads
another user's memory.

404.description: memory_not_found, also for another user's item

put.description:
Turns the caller's memory on or off. Off, nothing is written or retrieved for
them; stored items stay until they delete them.

get.description:
What every model call of a turn saw (README §7). Off unless DEBUG_CONTEXT_ENABLED.
It reaches a conversation outside a turn, so it does not go through the turn
runner's binding and checks ownership itself: only the conversation's owner
reads it (ADR-0059).

get.description:
The values the gateway enforces itself, in force now; it reads them at most every 10 s and
keeps the last ones it read when this cannot be reached (ADR-0283).

details.title: Details
details.description: What is wrong, e.g. a policy's validation errors.

AttachmentRegistration.title: AttachmentRegistration
AttachmentRegistration.description: The gateway registers an upload it stored in MinIO (ADR-0129).

warnings.title: Warnings
warnings.description: Indexed with something the user should know (D7, ADR-0201).

object_key.title: Object Key
object_key.description: Where the gateway reads the bytes; never sent to a browser.

AttachmentWarning.title: AttachmentWarning
AttachmentWarning.description: D7 (ADR-0201): `count` pages of an indexed PDF held too little text and were not read.

source.title: Source
source.description: Kind of source, e.g. web, doc, kb, sql.

locator.title: Locator
locator.description: Page, section or row range inside the source.

document_id.title: Document Id
document_id.description: The attachment (or KB document) the answer drew on (ADR-0140).

pages.title: Pages
pages.description: Pages of that document the answer drew on, ascending (ADR-0140).

next_before.title: Next Before
next_before.description: Pass as `before` for the next page; absent on the last page.

messages.title: Messages
messages.description: Oldest first; a retracted exchange is left out.

title.title: Title
title.description: The conversation's first question, at most 80 characters (ADR-0192).

last_turn_at.title: Last Turn At
last_turn_at.description: When the latest finished turn ended.

packages.title: Packages
packages.description: Every model call of the turn, in assembly order.

EffectiveLimits.title: EffectiveLimits
EffectiveLimits.description: What the gateway enforces itself, from the settings in force (ADR-0283).

mcp.title: Mcp
mcp.description: MCP servers and their disabled tools (I8).

text.title: Text
text.description: The post-guard text, the text later turns see (ADR-0193).

attachments.title: Attachments
attachments.description: The files sent with a question, when recorded (ADR-0193).

reason.title: Reason
reason.description: not_connected | missing | schema_mismatch | server_<why the server is disabled>

reason.title: Reason
reason.description: Why disabled: profile, external_not_allowed, external_in_airgap, no_url, no_token.

MCPServerHealth.title: MCPServerHealth
MCPServerHealth.description: One server of config/mcp.yaml as this environment runs it (I8): content-free, no URL or token.

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Whether memory is written and retrieved for this user.

version.title: Version
version.description: The stored version in force; 0 for none.

ignored.title: Ignored
ignored.description: When the stored version fails the rules against the files: the rules it fails, and the files' values are in force.

tasks_abandoned.title: Tasks Abandoned
tasks_abandoned.description: Tasks that ignored their cancellation since the agent started.

change.title: Change
change.description: flagged / unflagged: another policy's change made this one an exception, or cleared it (ADR-0115).

actor_username.title: Actor Username
actor_username.description: The actor's username at the time (ADR-0123); none on older rows.

actor_name.title: Actor Name
actor_name.description: The actor's display name at the time (ADR-0123); none on older rows.

induced.title: Induced
induced.description: Policies whose exception flag this change set or cleared (ADR-0115).

PolicyChangeView.title: PolicyChangeView
PolicyChangeView.description: One change of a policy, written by the agent in the change's transaction (ADR-0108).

purpose.title: Purpose
purpose.description: test: made by a test script, hidden from the admin list by default.

PolicyDocument.title: PolicyDocument
PolicyDocument.description:
A policy as the admin API reads and writes it (README §10.1). On create and on a new
version, `version` is ignored: the store assigns it (I2).

rows.title: Rows
rows.description: Matched evaluations of real turns per UTC day, policy and action.

PolicyOverrides.title: PolicyOverrides
PolicyOverrides.description: What a draft would override if saved now, and whether that makes it an exception.

principal.description: Whom to evaluate for; default: the admin, with no policy roles.

target.title: Target
target.description: DATA only; default: the first target, else answer.

PolicyTestRequest.title: PolicyTestRequest
PolicyTestRequest.description:
Evaluates one policy, stored (`policy_id`, its current version, on or off) or a draft
(`policy`), against sample text on the runtime engine path; nothing is recorded.

action.title: Action
action.description: What the engine decided for this text.

explanation.title: Explanation
explanation.description: The checker's explanation in English, as traces record it.

explanation_key.title: Explanation Key
explanation_key.description: The explanation as a key under the web's policies.explanation.* (rule 7).

explanation_args.title: Explanation Args
explanation_args.description: Arguments of explanation_key; `items` lists names separated by newlines.

spans.title: Spans
spans.description: Matched regions of `text`, by character offsets.

output_text.title: Output Text
output_text.description: The text after redaction, for text checkpoints.

error.title: Error
error.description: The checker's error, when it failed (see on_error).

created_by_username.title: Created By Username
created_by_username.description: The creator's username at the time (ADR-0123); none on older rows.

created_by_name.title: Created By Name
created_by_name.description: The creator's display name at the time (ADR-0123); none on older rows.

overrides.title: Overrides
overrides.description: What this version overrode when it was saved.

exception.title: Exception
exception.description: Whether it was an exception when it was saved.

created_by_username.title: Created By Username
created_by_username.description: The creator's username at the time (ADR-0123); none on older rows.

created_by_name.title: Created By Name
created_by_name.description: The creator's display name at the time (ADR-0123); none on older rows.

updated_at.title: Updated At
updated_at.description: When the policy's head (current version, switch) last changed.

overrides.title: Overrides
overrides.description: id@version of the wider policies of its group it overrides among the current versions, recomputed for the whole group on every change (ADR-0108).

exception.title: Exception
exception.description: It overrides a stricter policy of its group (ADR-0105, ADR-0108).

code.title: Code
code.description: whole_text_cannot_lift_spans: this exception cannot lift span-based redaction.

policies.title: Policies
policies.description: id@version of the span-based policies it cannot lift.

source.title: Source
source.description: Where it is set; changing it needs a redeploy.

package.title: Package
package.description: The ContextPackage a model call received, with its accounting.

reason.title: Reason
reason.description: Error code that withdrew the reply.

key.title: Key
key.description: The setting's id, e.g. turn.per_user_max or mcp.rag.max_concurrency.

nullable.title: Nullable
nullable.description: null is a value: no limit of its own.

per_tenant.title: Per Tenant
per_tenant.description: The value is a map from tenant id to a count.

default.title: Default
default.description: The files' value (the environment's, where it sets one).

value.title: Value
value.description: The value in force: the override, or the default.

source.title: Source
source.description: The file and key of the default.

server.title: Server
server.description: An MCP server's id, for its max_concurrency.

overrides.title: Overrides
overrides.description: Every override the new version holds; a key left out is its default.

expected_version.title: Expected Version
expected_version.description: The version the draft was made from; another save first is 409.

changed.title: Changed
changed.description: The keys whose value in force the draft changes.

SettingsProblem.title: SettingsProblem
SettingsProblem.description: Why a draft cannot be saved: a rule it breaks or a range it leaves, in plain words.

version.title: Version
version.description: The version whose overrides come back, as a new version.

changes.title: Changes
changes.description: Each value in force the save changed, before and after.

SimulatedPrincipal.title: SimulatedPrincipal
SimulatedPrincipal.description: A principal for the test panel: which tenant and policy roles to evaluate the policy for.

params.title: Params
params.description: The ids the rule names: capability, tool, server.

strict.title: Strict
strict.description: inner < outer when true, inner ≤ outer when false.

parents.title: Parents
parents.description: The rules whose inner bound is this pair's outer one: its parent rows (ADR-0286).

TimeoutPair.title: TimeoutPair
TimeoutPair.description:
One nested pair of the timeout budget's rules (app/resilience/budget.py), on the values in force
or on a draft's.

conversation_id.title: Conversation Id
conversation_id.description: UUID, lower-case; the gateway normalises it (ADR-0050).

attachment_ids.title: Attachment Ids
attachment_ids.description: Attachments sent with this turn; the agent loads them after the ownership check (A1).

top_user_in_flight.title: Top User In Flight
top_user_in_flight.description: The busiest user's turns in flight: a count, never who.
